title: Show a quicklist the way apps pinned to the Task Manager do
line: An app in an Icon widget now shows the same Places or Recent Files list in its context menu as when it is pinned to the Task Manager.
explanation: The Icon widget's context menu only listed the actions from the app's desktop file. The Task Manager additionally shows the user's Places for file managers and the app's recent files for other apps, built in its own backend in plasma-desktop, which the widget can't use. The change builds the same lists in the Icon widget each time its menu opens: Places (with the other place groups in submenus) for file managers, otherwise up to five recent files with a Forget Recent Files entry, under section headings, and puts an Actions heading above the app's own actions when both are shown.

commits.message:
applets/icon: show Places and Recent Files like the Task Manager

An app in the Icon widget only offered its own desktop file actions, but
the same app pinned to the Task Manager also lists the user's Places for
file managers and recent files otherwise. Show those in the widget too.

BUG: 396539
